notes.note: #0.112-141 pair block (+111+2k). 0603.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain 9,10,8,6,7,15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1 = Wing Zero, 00, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1. So #0.136/137 = Momotaros (rough 'nuah'), #0.138/139 = RX, #0.140/141 = Rider 1. Wording confirms the order across all blocks (Den-O slot is always the Momotaros line).

#0.143-157 leader block (+142+k), same order: #0.146 Nu ('chii'), #0.147 Zeta ('zo'), #0.148 Zero ('ze'), #0.154 W (identical apart from a line break, so identical English), #0.155 Momotaros. Subject 'they' = the Virgo mobile dolls.

#0.159-173 hurt-cry block (+158+k): Wing Zero, 00, God, Nu, Zeta, then the Ultras (katakana cries), OOO, W, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1. #0.162 'konna tokoro de' kept as 'Not in a place like this!!' (implied 'I can't lose/fall').

#0.180-194 reaction block (+179+k) to Cherudim/Sandrock/Birth arriving. 'Yoku kite kureta' = 'Glad you made it!!'; 'tasukatta' = 'You saved me'. #0.194 Rider 1 'sumanai' read as grateful apology ('I'm in your debt'), not a plain apology.
Duo's catchphrase phrasing follows the earlier 'The God of Death is comin' through!!' line; 'ora ora ora' rendered as 'Outta the way, outta the waaay!!'.
Birth (Date) 'oshigoto oshigoto' = his money-minded 'this is just a job' joke.
{8074} = party/leader name variable; padding dropped per brief. Lockon urges the main party on while the reinforcements hold the line.

#0.2-16 leader block (+1+k), same chain as 0603: #0.2 Wing Zero, #0.3 00, #0.4 God, #0.5 Nu, #0.6 Zeta, #0.7 Zero, #0.8 Mebius, #0.9 Taro, #0.10 Seven, #0.11 Ultraman, #0.12 OOO; W, Momotaros, RX, Rider 1 follow in story_112. Identical Japanese kept identical.
Seravee (Tieria) reacting to yet another Virgo wave.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant order taken from the 0603/0605 Pt_Chara_Check chain (Wing Zero, 00, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1), confirmed by the Momotaros wording in every Den-O slot. Uncertain: #0.194 'sumanai' read as gratitude; #0.202 'ora ora ora' rendering. No new names.
